Cameron Smith says returning to the PGA Tour is "where I want to be now, without a doubt."

He tees off Thursday at The Lakes on a past-champion exemption. 3-time winner here.

The mission starts now. #GolfFanrecap #AustralianPGA

WIN a co-sanctioned PGA/DP World Tour event
OR finish TOP 10 in DP World Tour's season-long points race.

The BMW Australian PGA is his opening move. #GolfFanrecap #CamSmith
